issues.description: 461 integration test failures at TestHarness.init() due to ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence check constraint violation in tests/integration/helpers.zig:362 ensureDefaultOidcSeeds. The harness INSERT sets tenant_type='test' but does not supply production_tenant_id; the constraint requires (tenant_type='test') -> (production_tenant_id IS NOT NULL). Minimum-impact fix: change tenant_type='test' to tenant_type='production' (or include production_tenant_id in the INSERT) so the row satisfies the constraint. Expected to recover ~461 failing tests.

test_iss503_rls_removal pre-flight (TC-ISS503-04) detected 1 tenant still in LEGACY_RLS mode and refuses to proceed with RLS removal. The default tenant's storage_mode was not migrated to SCHEMA before the test ran. Likely secondary effect of the harness INSERT not committing storage_mode='SCHEMA' to the persistent default tenant row.
TC-EXP-402-02 fails with 'could not determine data type of parameter $2' at src/engine/reconstruction.zig:315 markRestoredOrphanInTx. SQL placeholder needs explicit type cast per INV-TI-3.
